rationale: Confirmed real repeated work: R1 canonical/identifier rebuild filename fields per query; R1.5 fields reconstruct canonical or expanded corpus statistics, and Mechanics tokenizes every field per lane before caching projected terms; R1.6 reconfigured shares already validated source/postings for parameter-only clones. These are bounded experimental consumers with different evidence shapes; lower R1 serialized B bytes/peak compare richer A metadata and cannot prove expansion saves memory. Current SourceSearch and Localization lanes remain two maintained measurement consumers. Acceptance must profile cold/warm preparation, per-query fields and refresh separately with identical source/analysis/runtime identities before proposing reuse; no speculative cache or copying object.__new__ clone into source.
